title: 听力挑战 · 猜测包裹去向

rounds.speaker: 同事
rounds.line: I cannot find my package. Where could it be?
rounds.lineCn: 我找不到我的包裹了,它可能在哪儿?

grammar.name: 情态动词 could 表推测
grammar.note: could 表示'可能',用于对现在情况的推测。

options.text: It might be at the front desk.
options.feedback: might be 表示推测位置,语气合理自然。

options.text: It is definitely in my hand.
options.feedback: 语气过于肯定,且与找不到包裹矛盾。
谈的是将来到达,不是推测当前位置。

rounds.speaker: 同事
rounds.line: Do you think the delivery has come today?
rounds.lineCn: 你觉得今天的快递到了吗?

grammar.name: must have done 表肯定推测
grammar.note: must have + 过去分词,表示对过去情况相当肯定的推测。

options.text: It must have arrived this morning.
options.feedback: must have arrived 对过去到达做肯定推测,恰当。

options.text: It has arrived in my hometown.
options.feedback: 快递到家乡与当前场景矛盾,答非所问。
一般现在时谈惯例,没有推测今天的快递。

rounds.speaker: 同事
rounds.line: Why is the box still missing from the shelf?
rounds.lineCn: 箱子为什么还不在架子上?

grammar.name: may have done 表可能推测
grammar.note: may have + 过去分词,表示对过去发生情况的可能推测。

options.text: Someone may have taken the wrong box.
options.feedback: may have taken 对过去情况的推测,解释了原因。
一般现在时谈习惯,不能解释箱子为何消失。

options.text: The box is empty and light.
options.feedback: 描述箱子状态,没有推测去向。
